# Pixel Stopwatch

A fully offline, single-page pixel-art stopwatch built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No packages, no network requests, no external assets.

## Features

- Large `mm:ss.cs` display
- Start, Stop, Lap, and Reset controls
- Numbered lap list with split times
- Keyboard accessible controls with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px
- Pixel-themed card on a patterned background

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Controls

| Button | Action |
|--------|--------|
| Start  | Start or resume the stopwatch |
| Stop   | Pause the stopwatch |
| Lap    | Record the current time as a lap |
| Reset  | Stop and clear all times and laps |

### Keyboard Shortcuts

- `Space` — Start / Stop (when focus is not on a button)
- `L` — Record a lap
- `R` — Reset
- `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` — Move focus between controls
- `Enter` / `Space` — Activate focused button

## Files

- `index.html` — markup and structure
- `styles.css` — pixel-art theme and responsive layout
- `script.js` — stopwatch logic and lap tracking

## Technical Notes

- Timing uses `performance.now()` with `requestAnimationFrame` for accurate, drift-free display updates.
- Lap splits are calculated relative to the previous lap.
- All event listeners are attached with `addEventListener`; no inline handlers.
- The app makes zero network requests and works entirely offline.
